items.source: Most major Spring Web components have been updated to support this style of registration. You'll find that DispatcherServlet, FrameworkServlet, ContextLoaderListener and DelegatingFilterProxy all now support constructor arguments. Even if a component (for example, non-Spring, other third party) has not been specifically updated for use within WebApplicationInitializers, they still may be used in any case. The ServletContext API allows for setting init-params, context-params, etc programmatically.
items.translation: 大多数主要的 Spring Web 组件均已更新以支持这种注册方式。您会发现 `DispatcherServlet`、`FrameworkServlet`、`ContextLoaderListener` 和 `DelegatingFilterProxy` 现在都支持构造函数参数。即使某个组件（例如非 Spring 的或其他第三方组件）尚未针对在 `WebApplicationInitializers` 中使用而专门更新，它们仍然可以在任何情况下使用。ServletContext API 允许通过编程方式设置 init-params、context-params 等。

items.source: Implementations of this SPI will be detected automatically by SpringServletContainerInitializer, which itself is bootstrapped automatically by any Servlet container. See its Javadoc for details on this bootstrapping mechanism.
items.translation: 此 SPI 的实现将由 `SpringServletContainerInitializer` 自动检测，而该初始化器本身会由任何 Servlet 容器自动引导。有关此引导机制的详细信息，请参阅其 Javadoc。

items.source: This style is both simpler and more concise. There is no concern for dealing with init-params, etc, just normal JavaBean-style properties and constructor arguments. You are free to create and work with your Spring application contexts as necessary before injecting them into the DispatcherServlet.
items.translation: 这种风格既更简单又更简洁。无需处理 init-params 等，只需使用普通的 JavaBean 风格的属性和构造函数参数。您可以在将 Spring 应用程序上下文注入到 `DispatcherServlet` 之前，根据需要创建和操作它们。
